name: Shinty Player Eilidh

intro.text: No hurling jokes! It's shinty. Same sort of idea, different sort of stick, a lot more shouting. Come on.

win: Good camanachd! You'd fit on our team. We'd put you in goal.
after: In shinty, you can hit the ball in the air. It's the only sport where the ball and the head share the same space regularly.
